changed_variables: extended historical period probe(확장 과거 기간 탐침)
prior research utilization audit(이전 연구 활용 감사)
comparison_baseline: Stage267 run267A(267A 실행) initial scoreboard(초기 점수판) plus source Stage258/262/264/265(258/262/264/265단계) evidence.
control_variables: candidate pool fixed to five initial Baseline candidates(기준 후보)
no ONNX(ONNX) work until goal gate(목표 게이트)
decision_use: This run can decide what to execute next for R&D racing(연구개발 경주), Adapter development(어댑터 개발) eligibility, and candidate downgrade(후보 하향). It cannot select an operating baseline(운영 기준선) or start ONNX(ONNX) review.
failure_criteria: A candidate needs a unique relaxed gate(완화 게이트) to be compared.
Only one metric(지표) or one month(월) drives the next repair loop.
hypothesis: The five Baseline candidates(기준 후보) should be compared by break resistance(깨짐 저항), not by single best KPI(단일 최고 핵심 성과 지표).
invalid_conditions: feature order(피처 순서), model file(모델 파일), or MT5 report(메타트레이더5 보고서) identity is missing
source files cannot be read because of path length(경로 길이) without recording the long-path access note
candidate-specific settings are changed without a manifest(목록)

stop_conditions: If extended period(확장 기간), ablation(제거), replacement(대체), or equity zoom(평가금 확대) breaks a candidate, downgrade it instead of opening endless repair(무한 수리).
If a repair branch(수리 분기) would need more than two stages(두 단계), close or pivot(마감 또는 전환).
If evidence is missing, mark missing_required(필수 누락), blocked(차단), or out_of_scope_by_claim(주장 범위 밖).
success_criteria: All five candidates have executable manifests(실행 가능 목록) for the same period and ablation/replacement surface.
Balance/equity graph(잔액/평가금 그래프) grading can be tied to exact MT5 report(메타트레이더5 보고서) images.
Ablation/replacement plan distinguishes upstream full feature categories(상류 전체 피처 범주) from the compressed stage gate features(압축 단계 게이트 피처).
